findings.finding: The 30 Sep NAV the report will carry is already computable from public prices at about 93 SEK/share (-3% vs the published 96 at 31 Aug), driven by Avanza (15.907m shares, 402.7 -> 384.9 SEK) and Silex (11.087m shares, 177.2 -> 170.35 SEK), which together are 64% of NAV; the stock (87.05 on 30 Sep, 86.6 sealed) already sits at a ~7% discount to that figure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Creades' own report days moved +1.09 (2025-01-23), +2.04 (2025-04-15), -0.94 (2025-07-11), +0.82 (2025-10-14), +1.32 (2026-01-22), 0.00 (2026-04-15), +5.03 (2026-07-14, the same morning Avanza reported and rose 4.04%); monthly NAV release days median about 1.1% absolute.

findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the listed marks are on the public tape and the share fell from 90.80 (31 Aug) to 87.05 (30 Sep) alongside them. Filed because it is the reported line; worth 0 under the 'already told' rule.

findings.finding: Instabee (338 MSEK, 2.6% of Creades' NAV, held at a value Creades had already written down) put out a firmer outlook on 30 Sep, after the 31 Aug mark: its CEO told Bloomberg he expects 2026 EBITDA of SEK 150-200m after a first full-year profit in 2025. That gives a small reason to expect the Q3 unlisted mark to hold or rise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Unlisted marks moved little in Q2 (Q2 report: Mentimeter 'more or less unchanged valuations for the quarter'); no observed reaction to an unlisted revaluation alone.
findings.original_quote: räknar med ett ebitda på 150–200 miljoner kronor under 2026 [expects an EBITDA of SEK 150-200 million in 2026]
findings.why_not_priced: Creades' unlisted marks are only disclosed quarterly and the market cannot see the Q3 Instabee value; if this were priced, Creades would have outperformed its listed look-through since 30 Sep, and it has not (its discount to the computed NAV widened from 5% to ~7%). But it is a CEO outlook relayed by wire, a proxy for a valuation-model input, on 2.6% of NAV, so it stays small.

Avanza (49% of NAV) reports Q3 on 16 Oct 2026, two sessions after the window; the July 14 Creades +5.03% coincided with Avanza's same-day report, which will not recur this time.
Dividend record date 28 Oct 2026 (quarterly instalment, already decided).
